ha_attributes.title: EBS Identity and Access Management Integration Analyzer
ha_attributes.description: Check the setup and known issues for the Single Sign-On configuration: EBS Identity and Access Management Integration
ha_attributes.whats_new:
4/16/2025 - Analyzer Framework Version 6.26.3

  • Fixes an error in the Patch Wizard analyzer when there are no previous Patch Wizard request_set_id
  • Adds tool tip to Arrow when expanding collapsing result data
  • Updates Java requirement to ensure the analyzers still work on EBS servers with Java 1.7
  • Fixed g_banner_message and g_banner_severity framework global variable handling nulls, which prevented these global variables to be populated in newer releases of EBS

Introducing the NEW EBS Identity and Access Management Integration - EBS Tier.

The EBS Identity and Access Management Integration analyzer version is a java program that is run using a shell script. 
See Note 2778339.1 for detailed instructions.

Able to execute scripts, parse log files and collect their outputs.

Able to collect logs and files for review, everything is collected and zipped into a single uploadable zip file.
